verdict.rationale: Stripe's disputes docs say the Dashboard guides merchants through each dispute response, and Smart Disputes can automate evidence collection and submission for eligible disputes. Terminal payments are managed in the same Stripe Dashboard. Notification is only implied: webhooks deliver real-time events generically, but the pack never mentions dispute or chargeback events or alerts. Missing for 10: explicit chargeback notifications (dispute webhook events or alerts), deadline tracking and reminders, Terminal-specific or card-present dispute handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can get notified of chargebacks and submit dispute evidence before the deadline

citations.quote: To help you submit the best possible response for each dispute, Stripe guides you through the process in the Dashboard. Use Smart Disputes to automate evidence collection and submission for eligible disputes.
After you register a webhook endpoint, Stripe pushes real-time data to it when events occur.
You can manage both in-person payments and online payments in a unified system in the Dashboard.
